# shares content

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sharesContent`](gmeow-sharesContent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sharesContent>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a posting to content it shares or reposts — another posting, an article, a media object. The repost/share/boost edge. Non-functional. Projects to [schema:sharedContent.](https://schema.org/sharedContent.)

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPosting.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the repost / boost / share edge — a posting that forwards another posting, article, or media object wholesale; non-functional, so a posting may share several items.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for an inline quotation of selected text (use [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) / [`gmeow:quotedText`](gmeow-quotedText.md)) and avoid it on non-posting works — its domain is [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPosting.md).

### How to use

- Point the [`gmeow:FeedPosting`](../classes/gmeow-FeedPosting.md) at the shared resource via [`gmeow:sharesContent`](gmeow-sharesContent.md); it projects to [schema:sharedContent.](https://schema.org/sharedContent.) Pair with [`gmeow:quotesContent`](gmeow-quotesContent.md) when the repost also adds quoted commentary.

### Examples

- ex:repost [`gmeow:sharesContent`](gmeow-sharesContent.md) ex:originalPost.
